Resources from Empathy and Narrative Discussion Event 24th September 2021

Tags: Empathy

Fransina Stradling @f.stradling #1 2021-10-14 09:49 UTC

On 24th September 2021 @LynnEekhof and I hosted a discussion event to compare various approaches to measuring narrative empathy. Three speakers introduced their respective approaches to measuring empathy, after which attendees discussed these approaches in more depth in smaller groups. Please find each speaker’s slides below.
